# Love at First Bite VR

A high-stakes, comedic VR cooking simulator where you have 10 minutes to multitask a gourmet meal in a cramped student dorm kitchen before your crush arrives—ending with a  kiss if you succeed, or a slap in the face if you burn dinner

Team members: Stupu Eduard-Stefan, Tarca Catalin, Sescu Tiberiu, Firtescu Sebastian, Gheoca Razvan

# Description

1) Many university students living in dorms rely on repetitive, basic meals and feel intimidated when trying to cook an impressive, multi-part dish for someone special. While watching a 60-second recipe video on TikTok makes cooking look easy, real-world cooking fails because beginners lack spatial coordination, timing, and heat management when multiple burners are running at once. This app exists to give students a safe, zero-cost, and wildly entertaining environment to build kitchen confidence and multitasking muscle memory without wasting expensive ingredients or setting off the dorm smoke alarm.  
     
2) Using the Meta Quest 2, the player steps into a cramped 3D dorm kitchen with a strict 10-minute countdown timer triggered by a text from their crush. To succeed, the player must physically grab, chop, season, and stagger the cooking times of a three-part meal (such as pan-seared steak, sautéed sides, and garlic bread) across multiple heat sources so everything finishes hot at the same time. At the end of the timer, the crush NPC walks into the room in 1:1 scale to inspect the kitchen and taste the food, rewarding a well-cooked meal with a  kiss on the cheek, or punishing burnt food and a smoky room with a sharp haptic slap.  
     
3) Most VR games force a choice between dry educational training and pure arcade chaos. *Love at First Bite VR* stands out by grounding its mechanics in a highly relatable student scenario (hosting a date in a tiny dorm) and leveraging VR's unique sense of personal space—both through one-handed phone-texting distractions mid-cook and an unforgettable face-to-face NPC ending that makes players laugh out loud while genuinely improving their kitchen coordination. 

# Similar products & Relevant Links(\>=3)

**Cooking Simulator VR**  
**https\://store.steampowered.com/app/1358140/Cooking\_Simulator\_VR/**  
**Relevant Features**

- **(Physics & Prep):** 1:1 physical VR knife slicing, utensil grabbing, and realistic pan-flipping kinematics.  
- **(Thermal States):** Dynamic ingredient state transitions (raw $\rightarrow$ seared $\rightarrow$ burnt) based on stove burner temperature and exposure time.  
- **(Kitchen Hazards):** Interactive kitchen fire hazards and destructible environment elements when heat sources are neglected.

**Clash of Chefs VR (by Flat Hill Games)**  
**https\://www\.meta.com/experiences/clash-of-chefs-vr/3230671513714717/**  
**Relevant Features**

- **(Time Pressure):** Fast-paced countdown timers that force the player to juggle multiple cooking stations simultaneously under pressure.  
- **(Order Evaluation):** Instant visual scoring and expressive NPC customer reactions based on how fast and accurately the plate is served.  
- **(Spatial Layout):** U-shaped counter ergonomics designed specifically for Meta Quest room-scale turning and quick reachability.

**Lost Recipes (by Schell Games)**  
**https\://www\.meta.com/experiences/lost-recipes/4584847304916084/**  
**Relevant Features**

- **(Educational Transfer):** Designed to teach real-world transferable cooking techniques and heat control rather than chaotic food-throwing.  
- **(Step-by-Step Guidance):** Diegetic in-world recipe guidance and instant feedback from a virtual host/mentor NPC right in front of the counter.  
- **(Authentic Mechanics):** Realistic pouring, basting, and stove temperature management optimized for standalone Meta Quest headsets.

\-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Main Features 

**PRINCIPAL MAIN VERY IMPORTANT FEATURE:**

- **Real-time multitasking and heat management simulation.The core gameplay forces players to physically coordinate prepping, seasoning, and staggering the cooking times of a three-part meal across multiple heat sources so all components finish simultaneously.** 

**Other features:**

- **Interactive Physics-Based Cooking: Players must physically grab, chop, and season ingredients in 3D space rather than just pressing buttons.**   
- **Distraction & Time Management: The core cooking loop is interrupted by a strict 10-minute countdown timer and mid-cook, one-handed phone-texting distractions.**   
- **NPC Evaluation & Haptic Consequences: A 1:1 scale NPC enters at the end to inspect the food and kitchen, triggering either an affectionate reward or a "sharp haptic slap" for burnt food and a smoky room.**   
- **Environmental Simulation: The game takes place in a cramped dorm kitchen, forcing players to navigate and manage a realistically limited workspace without setting off the smoke alarm.**

# Technologies, Libraries, Assets (cu linkuri) (\>=5)

1. **Unity Engine (Unity 6 LTS)**: Core game engine used for the 3D dorm kitchen scene, physics simulation (PhysX), the 10-minute countdown logic, and the cooking state system (raw → cooked → burnt).  
    [https\://unity.com](https://unity.com)  
2. **Meta XR All-in-One SDK**: Integration with Meta Quest 2, including headset and controller tracking, grab interactions, haptic feedback (for the final “slap” reaction), and Android/Quest build support.  
    [https\://developers.meta.com/horizon/](https://developers.meta.com/horizon/)  
3. **Unity XR Interaction Toolkit**: Provides grabbable objects (knife, pan, seasoning), socket snapping to counters and burners, and base VR interaction components.  
    [https\://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/com.unity.xr.interaction.toolkit@latest](https://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/com.unity.xr.interaction.toolkit@latest)  
4. **Blender**: 3D modeling and asset editing for the dorm kitchen, utensils, and food in multiple states (raw, cooked, burnt).  
    [https\://www\.blender.org](https://www.blender.org)  
5. **Mixamo (Adobe)**: Character rigging and animations for the crush NPC (entering the room, inspecting the kitchen, reacting to the meal).  
    [https\://www\.mixamo.com](https://www.mixamo.com)  
6. **Sketchfab**: Source of free, Creative Commons-licensed 3D models such as stoves, pots, pans, and furniture, used with proper attribution.  
    [https\://sketchfab.com](https://sketchfab.com)  
7. **Freesound**: Sound effects library for sizzling, chopping, the smoke alarm, and phone message notifications.  
    [https\://freesound.org](https://freesound.org)  
8. **Unity Particle System / VFX Graph**: Visual effects for fire, smoke, and steam, which feed into the smoke-alarm and burnt-kitchen mechanics.  
    [https\://docs.unity3d.com/Manual/ParticleSystems.html](https://docs.unity3d.com/Manual/ParticleSystems.html)
